subject: Round-robin group demo cadence — confirm time options
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Moreno <sara@acmeretail.com>, Tom Hanley <tom.hanley@orbitfinance.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Round-robin group demo cadence — confirm time options

Hi Sara and Tom,

Thanks again for agreeing to the joint walkthrough with CloudBridge next week. We thought it would be efficient to run a short round-robin product demo that covers: 1) a high-level platform tour, 2) model serving patterns for multi-tenant apps, and 3) a quick QA on security/variant fallbacks. Total slot: 45 minutes.

Option windows (PDT):
- Tuesday 2027-08-31 10:00–10:45
- Wednesday 2027-09-01 16:00–16:45
- Thursday 2027-09-02 08:00–08:45

We can host the session and invite CloudBridge for a 10-minute partnership update at the start if that works. Please reply with your preferred slot and timezone constraints. If none of these work I can open a quick 15-minute sync to align.

Agenda (draft):
- 0–10m: CloudBridge partner intro + goals
- 10–30m: Redwood platform demo (hosting, dedicated, private)
- 30–40m: Q&A + security checklist
- 40–45m: Next steps / follow-ups

Attachments: demo-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda stub)

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com
From: Tom Hanley <tom.hanley@orbitfinance.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Sara Moreno <sara@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Round-robin group demo cadence — confirm time options

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the clear options.

Orbit prefers mornings Eastern. The Thursday morning PDT slot (Thursday 08:00 PDT -> 11:00 EDT) would work best for our team. We have two engineers who need to join and one director who will drop in for 20 minutes.

If that slot is confirmed, can you also share a short pre-demo checklist for the security questions so we can pull notes?

Tom Hanley
Head of Platform, Orbit Finance
tom.hanley@orbitfinance.com

I attached the calendar invite and the agenda. Please accept the invite; Ben uploaded the pre-demo checklist and SOC2 artifact summary to the shared drive link here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1DemoAgenda
